def split_state(op,ml,length,ns):
 assert op.shape==(16,ns,512) and ml.shape==(16,ns,2)
 assert np.isfinite(op).all() and np.isfinite(ml).all()
 per=(length+ns-1)//ns;live=np.arange(ns)*per<length
 assert (ml[:,live,1]>0).all()
 assert (ml[:,~live,1].view(np.uint32)==0).all()
 assert (ml[:,~live,0]==np.float32(-3.0e38)).all()
 assert (op[:,~live,:].view(np.uint32)==0).all()
 return int(live.sum())

def load(ctx,ns):
 d=G/'results'/f'ctx{ctx}-ns{ns}';j=json.loads((d/'manifest.json').read_text());ext=dict(V.EXTENTS);ext.update({'act.opart':16*ns*512*4,'act.mlpart':16*ns*2*4})
 assert j['batch']==16 and j['input_batch']==1 and j['block_prefix']==ctx and j['reset_at']==3 and j['block'] and j['live_kv_enabled']
 assert j['token_ids']==[2,42,43,2,42,43] and len(j['steps'])==6
 rows=[]
 for ix,s in enumerate(j['steps']):
  assert s['step']==ix and s['input_token']==j['token_ids'][ix] and len(s['tensors'])==len(ext)
  raw={t['name']:(d/t['file']).read_bytes() for t in s['tensors']};assert set(raw)==set(ext) and all(len(raw[k])==n for k,n in ext.items())
  assert int(np.frombuffer(raw['in.kvlen'],dtype='<i4')[0])==ctx+1+ix%3
  assert int(np.frombuffer(raw['in.pos'],dtype='<i4')[0])==ctx+ix%3
  vals={k:np.frombuffer(v,dtype='<f4') if k in ['act.opart','act.mlpart'] else C.bf(v) for k,v in raw.items() if k not in ['in.pos','in.kvlen']}
  assert all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in vals.values())
  split_state(vals['act.opart'].reshape(16,ns,512),vals['act.mlpart'].reshape(16,ns,2),ctx+1+ix%3,ns)
  if ix>=3:
   for k in raw:assert raw[k]==rows[ix-3][0][k],(ix,k,'reset mismatch')
  rows.append((raw,vals))
 return rows
def accepted(m):

 for path,h in json.loads((G/'VALIDATOR-V2-FREEZE.json').read_text()).items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,path
 for path,h in json.loads((G/'FREEZE.json').read_text()).items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,path
 for path,h in json.loads((L/'REPLAY-INPUTS.json').read_text())['files'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,path
 for path,target in json.loads((G/'SYMLINKS.json').read_text()).items():assert os.readlink(path)==target,path
 V.D=B/'block-gates';base=V.load(ctx,'default');same_ns=V.load(ctx,'candidate');rows=load(ctx,ns);records=[];failures=[]
 for ix,((raw,vals),(br,bv),(nr,nv)) in enumerate(zip(rows,base,same_ns)):

  assert np.isfinite(merged).all()

  records.append(dict(step=ix,observed_upstream_exact=True,reset_exact=True,native_metrics=met,ns33_candidate_metrics={k:C.metrics(nv[k],vals[k]) for k in ['act.at','act.x']},fp64_final=refm,fp64_rne_mismatches=int(np.count_nonzero(bits!=rne)),fp64_merged_partials=C.metrics(ref,merged)))
 r=dict(passed=not failures,context=ctx,ns=ns,rows=6,records=records,failures=failures,scope='Native block5 B1 active/widest16, NS only, unchanged .003 attention/.01 block + abs bounds against qualified scalar; exact observed upstream/reset, full active opart/ML extent, first2048KVrows only. FP64 comparison diagnostic, split grouping differs. No timing/fullmodel')
 (G/f'qualification-v2-ctx{ctx}-ns{ns}.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in r.items() if k not in ['records','failures']}))
 if failures:raise SystemExit(1)

 C.self_test();V.self_test()
 good={'act.at':dict(relative_l2=.003),'act.x':dict(relative_l2=.01,max_abs=.07,max_ref=1.)};assert accepted(good)
 import copy
 for key,field,v in [('act.at','relative_l2',.003001),('act.x','relative_l2',.010001),('act.x','max_abs',.070001),('act.at','relative_l2',float('nan'))]:

 print('PASS fixed-boundary and four reject cases')
 op=np.zeros((16,132,512),dtype=np.float32);ml=np.zeros((16,132,2),dtype=np.float32);ml[:,:131,1]=1;ml[:,131,0]=np.float32(-3e38)
 assert split_state(op,ml,8193,132)==131
